title: Add gating metrics emission and tracing
author: Caleb Johnson
description: This PR instruments the Optimize quality-gate execution path with (1) low-cardinality metrics for funnel + latency + retry/timeout visibility, (2) OpenTelemetry tracing spans across Optimize -> eval-harness -> persistence -> policy enforcement, and (3) structured logs to make it possible to debug why a gate run failed/was retried/was blocked without needing to scrape application logs. Motivation: during the internal beta we’ve had multiple “it failed but we don’t know where” cases (eval-harness timeouts vs persistence retries vs policy-block) and we need consistent signals before we expand to limited production rollout. Scope: metrics, traces, and logs for gate runs, plus guardrails around tag cardinality and PII. Non-goals: dashboards/alerts (tracked in observability-pack PR) and any changes to gating pass/fail logic. Implementation details: Adds a top-level span `quality_gate.run` with child spans for baseline selection, config-diff validation, eval-harness trigger, result aggregation, and apply-block enforcement. Adds counters + histograms under `redwood.optimize.quality_gates.*` and emits one final structured log per gate run completion with stable reason codes. Metrics include: started/completed (by status), duration, eval-harness latency, retry count, timeout count, and flake_score distribution (if present). Tag set is intentionally constrained: `model_family`, `config_type` (batching|cache|quant), `gate_tier` (smoke|full), `status`, `failure_reason` (enum), `region`, `route_tier` (self_serve|enterprise), `runtime_sku` (coarse), and `eval_harness_version`. We do NOT tag by route_id, account_id, prompt_set_id, or model_version to avoid cardinality blowups; those are instead included in structured logs (hashed/shortened) and trace attributes behind sampling. Adds log redaction for any user-provided config payloads; logs only diff summary + validated knob names. Includes unit tests for reason-code mapping + a small integration test asserting we emit spans/metrics on a forced timeout path.

conversation: Allison Grant (review): Metric names look good. Two asks: (1) please add an explicit allowlist for tag keys/values so we don’t accidentally introduce route_id/account_id tags later, and (2) can we standardize failure_reason values to the same enums in the runbook/dashboards (timeout, regression, flake_quarantined, validation_failed, internal_error, canceled)?

Caleb Johnson (author): Added TagPolicy allowlist + an assertion in metrics wrapper (throws in dev, drops tag in prod w/ warning log). Also updated failure_reason to a single enum (QualityGateFailureReason) and mapped legacy strings to it. Included the list in docs/internal/observability/quality-gates-metric-catalog.md.

Sean Gallagher (review): Please make sure duration histograms are in ms and have sane buckets. Also add one metric that can serve as a top-level SLI: % gate runs completed within X minutes (or at least `duration_ms` with p95). We’ve seen stalls during GPU scarcity and want to alert on that later.

Caleb Johnson (author): Updated histogram units to ms and used the platform defaults (1s..30m). Added `redwood.optimize.quality_gates.duration_ms` and `...eval_harness.latency_ms`. The SLI can be derived from duration_ms + completed counter (we’ll wire alert rules in observability-pack).
Sergio Costa (review): For traces, can we ensure attributes won’t explode cardinality in the tracing backend? In particular, please don’t attach full config diffs or prompt set identifiers.

Caleb Johnson (author): Confirmed. Trace attributes are limited to coarse identifiers (model_family/config_type/gate_tier/status/reason). I removed `prompt_set_ids` from span attrs and kept it only in the completion log as a redacted summary: count + a short hash list behind debug sampling.
Jordan Lee (review): On apply enforcement: please ensure we emit a metric when apply is blocked due to failing gate vs missing gate vs gate pending. That’s important for policy debugging.

Caleb Johnson (author): Added `redwood.optimize.quality_gates.apply_blocked_total{block_reason=failed|missing|pending|override_required}` + span event `apply_blocked` with same reason. Included in telemetry test.

Chloe Martin (review): Structured log format: can you include gate_run_id and recommendation_id consistently? Console relies on gate_run_id for drill-down and we’ve had mismatches in other components.

Caleb Johnson (author): Updated structured logger wrapper to include `gate_run_id`, `recommendation_id`, and `config_diff_id` across all gate logs; added tests asserting presence. Also fixed one path where we were logging a generated uuid rather than persisted gate_run_id.
Sean Gallagher (approve): LGTM after the bucket change + apply_blocked metric. Thanks for being strict about tag policy.
Allison Grant (approve): Approved. Please follow up with PR to add these metrics to the observability standard doc if it diverges.
ci_notes: Initial run failed on integration tests due to OTEL exporter not being initialized in the integration harness. Fixed by using the existing test OTel provider and disabling network exporters in tests. Re-ran CI; all checks green.
release_notes: Internal: Quality gate runs now emit standardized metrics, traces, and structured logs for debugging and SLO tracking.
Internal: Added apply-blocked reason metrics to distinguish policy enforcement failures from eval-harness failures.
